text:
mira: kicking off RC creation for hotfix-42, targeting prod promo this evening (change window 22:00-23:30 UTC). artifact: gcr.io/redwood/release:hotfix-42-20260323sha12. Requesting quick signoff + smoke.
alex: looking. I'll run the local smoke suite and kv-warm on staging. ETA 10m.
sasha: tagging infra to watch for any warmup hiccups. Can we pin the worker version to v2.13 for this RC?
mira: yes, pin to worker:v2.13 to avoid the new scheduler change. add pin in promo doc.
jordan: note for rollback: if 95th latency > 450ms for 5m or error rate delta > 1% we'll rollback. Putting that in the decision doc.
dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] RC artifact validated, checks passed: image-scan OK, schema-match OK, artifact-size 112MB. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m. Run `/deploy plan rc hotfix-42 --canary 2,10,50 --metric latency95=450ms,error_rate_delta=1%` to stage.
olivia: QA smoke done on staging: smoke-01 and smoke-02 passed. found a small warning in reranker logs but not blocking. attaching logs: ```/var/log/reranker/warn.log: line 87: soft-eval timeout 120ms -> 121ms```
alex: local smoke green. kv warm completed. perf quick-check: p95=210ms, error_rate=0.02% on staging.
sasha: infra note: rolling upgrade lock acquired on region-us-east-1. No maintenance windows conflict.
mira: cool. Who's owning promo? @alex or @jordan?
alex: I can own promo and rollbacks. I'll be on pager.
jordan: I'll shadow and handle traffic routing if we need to divert.
mira: ok final checklist: 1) artifact pinned to worker:v2.13 (done) 2) deploy-bot plan approved 3) QA smoke green 4) rollback criteria set 5) oncall assigned (alex). Anyone object?
sasha: no objections. +1
olivia: +1
dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promo plan created: promo-id rc-hotfix-42-1793456789. /deploy promote rc-hotfix-42 --promo-id rc-hotfix-42-1793456789 --quietwindow 22:00-23:30UTC queued.
alex: starting staged promo now (canary 2%). Posting live checks.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] Smoke run at canary 2%: all healthchecks OK. latency95=218ms, error_rate=0.03%.
alex: advancing to 10% per plan. watching metrics.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] 10% check: latency95=235ms, error_rate=0.04%, no increase in DB RPS.
jordan: traffic routing OK. No autoscaler churn.
alex: advancing to 50%.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] 50% check: latency95=410ms (close to threshold), error_rate=0.9% (below rollback threshold). Observed a small GC blip on a single host, infra notified.
sasha: investigating GC. Temporarily mark host out of rotation if it trends.
alex: hold on final 100% until GC root cause mitigated for a couple minutes.
mira: agree, don't finish rollout yet. If GC hits again, we'll rollback.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] 2m watch: no further GC spikes; p95 stabilizing at 220-240ms on healthy hosts. error_rate consistent.
alex: going to 100% now.
dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion to 100% started. Promo-id rc-hotfix-42-1793456789.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] Post-promo verification: all routes healthy, latency95=238ms, error_rate=0.05%. No alerts.
mira: nice work. I'll draft the release note blurb and update the changelog: "hotfix-42: fix reranker timeout regression; pinned worker v2.13; canary rollout healed GC spike; observed no customer-impacting errors."
jordan: adding a postmortem bookmark to track the GC blip if it reoccurs.
alex: leaving a rollback marker in ops-runbook: `/ops rollback rc-hotfix-42 --reason p95>450ms or error_delta>1%`
mira: thanks everyone. I'll close the change ticket after I paste release notes.
sasha: thumbs up :thumbsup:
